findings.text: Use Cutting/Cafarella interview (Sudip Chakrabarti substack) + Quinlan/McKusick 2009 + The Register 'GFS II: Dawn of Multiplying Master Nodes' 2009-08-12 as community-canonical retrospective triad.
When citing GFS, always pair 2003 paper with 2009 Quinlan retrospective; do not claim Colossus rollout was clean break (was gradual ~10yr); distinguish 'D' block-server from Colossus metadata layer.

Frame GFS as 'canonical pedagogy + foundational citation' (alive) NOT 'active production system' (dead at Google). Lakehouse 'object store + table format + catalog' is 2026 default abstraction stack above the GFS-lineage layer.

Distinguish 'mechanism principles' (chunking/commodity HW/replication topology — generalize) from 'semantic contracts' (consistency model/append semantics — tied to org's app portfolio, rarely survive transplantation).

Audit any GFS-derived design for 5 anti-patterns: POSIX-assumption porting / small-file flood / latency-sensitive raw GFS / exactly-once misread of record-append / single-cell scaling assumption. W5 Colossus = cure, W1-W4 are workarounds.

In 2026 distributed-FS designs: assume failures, assume distributed metadata, default to strong consistency for user-facing, use EC for capacity tier + replication for hot/metadata tier. Workload-specific FS layers (Lustre/Weka) re-emerging only for AI training niche.

For GFS-pattern KG cross-ref: crystallize :StructuralPattern 'master-chunkserver-replication-canonical' with siblings HDFS/QFS/MooseFS/KFS/Ceph(variant)/Tectonic/Ozone/Colossus/GFS-original. TemporalArc Functor: monolithic-master -> HA-master -> distributed-metadata-over-KV.

For HDFS deployments: monitor NameNode heap+GC as P1 SLO, consider Federation/Ozone before 200M blocks. Treat record-append as at-least-once + bake framing (magic+length+checksum+UUID) into record format from day 1.

GFS architectural DNA survived but every component evolved. For new builds: object store + Iceberg + ML-driven tiering is 2026 default. Avoid all-flash assumption — hyperscaler verdict is tiered HDD+SSD.

Repeated pattern in Google stack 4x (GFS/Bigtable/Borg/MapReduce): single-master + workers + Chubby HA. Data-plane vs control-plane separation = canonical orthogonality lesson. Note 'Minnesota GFS' (Soltis) shares acronym only, architecturally unrelated.

Build :LineageGraph KG node distinguishing DIRECT_DESCENDANT (HDFS) vs ANTI_THESIS (Ceph/S3) vs SIBLING (HPC FS). Single-master debate = canonical :ArchitecturalDebate (Google's own Colossus migration validated distributed-metadata thesis at exabyte scale).

When mapping a system to GFS as analogy, audit on 7-axis pitfall taxonomy. Distinguish consistency-model / semantics / data-model / topology / durability-cost / evolution-vs-redesign conflations. Frame Colossus as redesign not increment.

Add :LineageEdge from GFS canonical -> Colossus/Tectonic/HDFS/JuiceFS DIRECT_DESCENDANT, -> S3/GCS/Iceberg/Delta/Hudi/Milvus/WebDataset ARCHITECTURAL_INHERITOR, -> IPFS/Storj/Weaviate EXPLICITLY_OPPOSED.
